subject: BrightLeaf SIG intake — proposed section owners and timeline
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightleafhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: sig-team@brightleafhealth.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake — BrightLeaf initial request

Hi Dylan / Redwood team,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our SIG. Attached is the completed questionnaire we started (BrightLeaf_SIG_Request_v1.xlsx) — sections 0–3 are filled, the rest are pending. Our audit window for this review is Feb 1–14 and we need draft responses back by Jan 22 to allow internal review.

Ask: could you confirm who on your side will own each SIG section and where evidence will be staged? We can accept links to a shared drive or SFTP for bulk artifacts.

Immediate priorities:
- Hold: responses for Access Control (section 6) and Change Management (section 9) — we will need evidence and owner contact
- Priority turnaround: legal/contract questions (section 2) for procurement

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Vendor Security
BrightLeaf Health
elena.ruiz@brightleafhealth.com

Attachment: BrightLeaf_SIG_Request_v1.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, sig-team@brightleafhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — BrightLeaf initial request

Elena — thanks for the packet and the timeline.

We can commit to the Jan 22 draft turnaround. I put together a first-pass owners CSV (redwood-section-assignments-draft.csv) and a short evidence plan. High-level proposals below — please confirm if these align with BrightLeaf expectations:

Proposed Redwood owners (first pass):
- Section 2 (Legal / Contracts): Monica Patel (Contracts & Compliance)
- Section 6 (Access Control): Markus Klein (Security Ops)
- Section 9 (Change Management): Markus Klein (Security Ops)
- Section 10 (System Development): Dylan Brooks (Platform Product)
- Remaining ops/security artefacts: Monica / Markus shared ownership

Evidence staging: we will create a restricted Drive folder and share links to section subfolders. For large logs we will provide SFTP access or transfer via our secure intake form (link to be provided).

Open questions:
- Do you need proof-of-encryption KMS manifests (we can provide KMS audit snapshots) or just config screenshots?
- For regulatory carve-outs, do you want raw audit logs or filtered extracts?

Next steps:
1) Monica and Markus — please review assignments below and reply with any ownership conflicts or suggested alternates by EOD Wed (Jan 14).
2) Elena — if BrightLeaf is OK with the proposed owners and Drive/SFTP approach, we will start populating section folders by Jan 16.

I attached the draft CSV mapping.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Platform PM — Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
